summary: Setting up an OAuth integration in Airtable is straightforward via the Builder Hub. The process involves registering the app, configuring redirect URLs, and selecting scopes, with no formal review process mentioned in the documentation.

approval.notes: The documentation does not mention a review or approval process for OAuth integrations.

steps.title: Access Builder Hub
steps.detail: Log in to your Airtable account and navigate to the OAuth integrations page.

steps.title: Register Integration
steps.detail: Click the 'Register an OAuth integration' button and provide a name and your OAuth redirect URL.

steps.title: Configure Scopes
steps.detail: Select the required scopes in the 'Scopes' section to define the permissions your integration needs.

steps.title: Retrieve Credentials
steps.detail: Copy your Client ID and generate an optional Client secret from the 'Developer details' section.

nuances: Airtable automatically revokes tokens after 60 days of inactivity.
OAuth integrations are limited to 20 per user.
Tokens can be revoked if the application sends incorrect credentials or violates security measures.
agent_can_do: Draft the app name and description.
Identify necessary scopes based on API requirements.
Store Client ID and Client Secret in secure environment variables.
human_must_do: Log in to the Airtable account.
Copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the dashboard.
